items.name: ai-chat
items.title: AI Chat
items.description: A complete chat app for Next.js: a new chat screen, conversations that stream replies, projects, search, rename and delete, a tools and model menu, share, copy, regenerate and edit.
items.docs:
Installs a full app under app/ai-chat. Run your dev server and open /ai-chat. Replace replyFor and the stream in lib/ai-chat/store.tsx with your model API.

It uses these theme tokens: background, card, muted, accent, border, primary and chart-2, chart-3.

items.name: file-manager
items.title: File Manager
items.description: A complete storage app for Next.js: overview with storage and member status, my files, shared, favorites, recent, trash and folder pages. Search, upload, rename, sort, list and grid all work.
items.docs:
Installs a full app under app/file-manager. Run your dev server and open /file-manager.

It uses these theme tokens: background, card, muted, accent, border, primary, destructive and chart-1 to chart-5.
